title: A number that another Part Library entry has exactly is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TAKEN-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • A different Part Library entry, {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TAKEN-02), is stocked at {Location-B} only, so {Location-A} does not stock it.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with {Part-B}, typed exactly.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  7. Type {Part-B} in the Part Library search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: nothing is saved and the window stays open. A red message reads "Part number {Part-B} already belongs to another part in the Part Library." with a second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this." It goes away after about 3 seconds.
  • Step 5: the window closes.
  • Step 6: the entry {Part-A} is still there, unchanged.
  • Step 7: the entry {Part-B} is still there, unchanged: there are still two entries.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-N1, §4 Key Decisions, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.2 (Both fields edited), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan §1 Clarifications, Q2. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (rename match rule): “A rename follows the same match rule as linking. A rename is refused only when another Part Library entry has exactly the typed number: the same characters, with the same upper and lower case.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part number already belongs to another entry): “"Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary context note: “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §1 Clarifications, Q2: “Exact (same characters and case), like create's link rule.”
